notes.title: Legendary Necromancer Gear and Inventory Caps!
notes.content:
1. Added Necromancer Legendary Sets (Holy, Thunder, Raging) to Gloom Vault Boss loot drops

2. Added inventory caps for item types (Avatars 100 max, Weapons 150 max, Avatar Parts 250 max) in order to stabilize accounts as some player accounts that have exceeded a certain number of items have gone awry. 

Currently we have not deleted excess inventory, however you can no longer pick up loot in the item type you have maxed out. 

NEXT FRIDAY 5/30 we will start deleting excessive items so please sell, trade or delete excessive items.

notes.title: Character Update: Stamina!
notes.content:
1. Introducing a New Character Resource: Stamina.

Stamina now manages all physical exertions including:
     Sprinting
     Jumping
     Climbing
     Melee Combat

Bandwidth now handles all “energy” related actions like Ranged Weapons.

Stamina will become a vital part of our upcoming profession “Athelete” and many others to follow.

We have also increased the top speed of normal movement to 4 Meters per Second, and Lowered base sprint with no mods to 5.

The HUD has been updated to reflect all the character resources, activate on the wrist menu under Settings-Graphics.

2. Karaoke room. Karaoke has been updated with improved reverb and time synch. To use the mics, grab them and press the trigger. You will no longer hear the monitor feedback but everyone else will hear you with the singing effects.

3. Windows Mixed Reality HMDs - we have tracked down a compatibility issue and addressed it. For it to work properly you will need to install Open XR tools for Windows Mixed Reality and be sure to set “Reprojection” on.

4. Have reset all the missions in Dead Wave as we get closer to launch.

notes.title: Avatar Update 1
notes.content:
1. As we continue to forge ahead with introducing our next generation of Avatar we are pushing some necessary changes to the current one. The crouch control on the joystick has been removed. We are now using a “Sitting & Standing” method.  The sitting /standing button is on the wrist menu under “movement.”  If you are sitting in RL you will automatically be set to “sitting” mode. If you stand in RL you will be automatically set to standing mode. If you sit again, you will crouch in game. To return to standing in game go to wrist menu and select “Sitting” and you will calibrate again. Hopefully this makes things easier for all. We will be watching it closely.

2. Addressed certain crashes on Quest Standalone being cause by Open XR errors

3. For those users who use the “Flatscreen” version of the game everyone should appear normal and vice versa.

notes.title: Character Upgrade Phase 0

4. We are proud to premiere our first character profession “Sharpshooter.” To monitor your progression go to the “Profession” tab in your “Character Window”

5. Every weapon type grants unique XP. Pistol, SMG, and Rifle. All ranged weapons also grant “Ranged XP.”

notes.content:
1. A new Art Exhibit has opened at the Riff XR Gallery honoring the works of the great Salvador Dali. Mr. Dali is set to arrive in COG form soon.

"Welcome to Riff XR’s celebration of the inimitable Salvador Dali, our newest curated exhibit in the Riff XR Gallery. This interactive showcase highlights the brilliant works of the twentieth century surrealist master, and we invite you to create new Dali-esque works by prompting our AI models with your own inspired subjects.

As you navigate the exhibit and marvel at the artist’s genius, simply stand before a canvas and use the “AI” button, speaking your prompt with the button held. In moments, the model will produce an entirely original work from your prompt. Logged-in users will find their artworks permanently cataloged at riffxr.com/gallery."

2. The Guest feature has been removed from the game for the foreseeable future. If you want to enter Riff you have to be logged in. All founders will get to permanently keep the guest avatars in their inventory. In a future update we will implement anonymous name tags.

notes.title: Enzo's Pizzeria Arcade Revamp!
notes.content:
Happy to announce the Enzo's Pizzeria Arcade revamp!

Emulate your favorite arcade games inside the world of Riff VR. Uncle Enzo's Pizzeria is located to the left of the Riff Tower, in the Riff Plaza map!

Get your friends involved and play together just like back in the old days, or discover a completely new side of gaming you never knew existed!
